name: rivet-memory
description: Persistent RivetOS memory for Claude Code: recall MCP tools, lifecycle capture, and agent-driven onboard (cloud vs your own hub).

RIVETOS_MODE.title: RivetOS mode
RIVETOS_MODE.description: cloud or local. Leave empty to use ~/.rivetos/.env (house nodes). Never set workspace or production here.

RIVETOS_DATAHUB_URL.title: DataHub URL
RIVETOS_DATAHUB_URL.description: Local-mode endpoint. postgres:// or postgresql:// maps to RIVETOS_PG_URL; https:// is stored as-is and not converted.

RIVETOS_EMBED_URL.title: Embed URL
RIVETOS_EMBED_URL.description: Optional embedding endpoint used with a Postgres DataHub.

RIVETOS_CLOUD_URL.title: Cloud URL
RIVETOS_CLOUD_URL.description: Cloud-mode API base. Default https://rivetos.cloud when mode is cloud and this is empty.

RIVETOS_CLOUD_TOKEN.title: Cloud token
RIVETOS_CLOUD_TOKEN.description: Secret from the Rivet Cloud dashboard. Never paste it into chat.

RIVETOS_MCP_ENABLE_MEMORY_WRITE.title: Enable memory write tools
RIVETOS_MCP_ENABLE_MEMORY_WRITE.description: Set to 1 only if you opt in during onboard. Default off. Shell/file/search write tools are not available in this kit.
